item: Index window over the post-import re-index drain (row 407, R825)
summary: One exclusive drain run drops the 13 non-unique keyword and when/where/who indexes (ix_mention_article and the 3 unique stay) when its backlog projects at least 5% of the mention rows (measured break-even 4% on a 2M-row encrypted store) and memory and disk were read and suffice, then rebuilds each once at its end with temp_store=MEMORY; a yield to an import leaves the marker for the next run; opening the store never rebuilds inline (a background heal does, at boot and after a restore); short memory keeps the marker and says so x12
